shots.focal_element: Workday wordmark with arc above and 'Adaptive Planning' product line beneath
shots.transition_other: first shot of the video; logo builds in on a plain white field
shots.typography: Lowercase rounded geometric sans wordmark (brand logotype) with registered mark; product line in title-case medium-weight humanist sans, normal tracking, stacked and centred under the wordmark
shots.what_happens: On white, the 'workday' letters wipe/reveal left to right while 'Adaptive Planning' fades up from a pale tint to full strength; by ~1.0 s the arc draws on above the wordmark and the lockup holds through the VO opening 'In this demo, we're going to quickly...' (w0-w8).
shots.build_rebuild: On a white 1920x1080 canvas, reveal the wordmark with a left-to-right clip-path wipe over 0.5 s, fade the product line from 30% to 100% opacity in parallel, then draw the arc stroke with stroke-dashoffset over 0.4 s ease-out and hold the lockup centred until 2.5 s.

shots.typography: Title-case medium/semibold neo-grotesque sans, normal tracking, single line centred; the title is misspelled on screen ('Forcasting')
shots.what_happens: The logo crossfades into a centred title that fades up from near-white and holds static while the VO states the demo goal (w9-w20, rolling forecast and variance analysis); in the final frame a large blue semicircle (two concentric tones) begins rising from the bottom edge, setting up the next shot.
shots.build_rebuild: Crossfade from the logo to a centred single-line title over ~0.4 s, hold for ~4 s, then start translating a two-tone blue circle (diameter wider than the frame) up from below the bottom edge in the last 0.3 s.

shots.focal_element: Full Company Summary dashboard screenshot in a floating window over a blue semicircle backdrop
shots.transition_other: blue semicircle rises from the bottom and a small dashboard window scales up from the centre over it
shots.typography: Product UI typography: small regular sans labels, large light-to-regular coloured KPI numerals, dense table text; header bar in white sans on blue; text is the app's own, not added captions (only the main panel labels are listed)
shots.what_happens: The blue arc sweeps up to fill the lower frame while a thumbnail-sized dashboard window scales up to nearly full width by ~8.0 s, then holds static with a soft drop shadow as the VO finishes 'using an automated and error-free process' (w21-w27).
shots.build_rebuild: Place a 1180px-wide dashboard screenshot with a soft drop shadow over a white background with a large blue circle rising from the bottom, and scale the screenshot from 0.25 to 1.0 with an ease-out over ~0.5 s, then hold.

shots.focal_element: 'Situation' bullet panel on the right beside the scaled-down dashboard on the left
shots.typography: Heading 'Situation' in bold title-case sans with a thin rule beneath extending to the right edge; three bullets in regular-weight title/sentence-case sans; the bullet matching the VO is set darker while the others are a lighter tint (active-item highlight)
shots.what_happens: The dashboard scales down and slides to the left half, revealing a right-hand 'Situation' panel; its three bullets highlight in turn in sync with the VO: 'Finance Director' at 'FP&A director' (w31-w33), 'End of April' at 'end of April' (w37-w39), 'Need a May forecast' at 'create the May forecast' (w43-w46).
shots.build_rebuild: Scale the dashboard from 1.0 to ~0.55 while translating it left over ~0.5 s, slide in a right-column heading with an underline and three bullets, and switch each bullet from a light tint to dark ink at the start word of its matching VO phrase.

shots.focal_element: Dashboard window returned to centre, cursor moving toward the header
shots.typography: Product UI typography only (small sans labels, large coloured KPI numerals); no added captions
shots.what_happens: The side panel is gone and the dashboard is back centred over the blue arc; a cursor moves across the upper part of the dashboard toward the header while the VO says 'you'll need the latest actuals from the general ledger' (w48-w59); in the last frame a grey overlay dims the window, signalling a menu or modal about to open.
shots.build_rebuild: Scale the dashboard back to centre over ~0.5 s, animate a cursor along a short path to the top header, and in the final 0.2 s fade a 40% grey scrim over the window before cutting to the next UI state.
